title: Prediction
description: Predict what happens when a React form submits normally.
prompt: A React form has controlled inputs, but its submit handler does not call event.preventDefault(). What is the most likely result?

options.label: The browser performs its default form submission and may reload the page.
React keeps control because the inputs are controlled.
The submit button automatically becomes disabled.

responses.react-keeps-control: Not quite. Controlled inputs keep field values in React state, but they do not cancel the browser's default submit behavior.
responses.browser-submits-document: Correct. A form submit is still an HTML form submit unless your handler prevents the default behavior.
responses.button-disabled: Not quite. Buttons do not automatically disable during submit. You need state for that.

metadata.reason: Catches the misconception that controlled inputs automatically replace native form behavior.
